# Universe In

> UK-registered study abroad consultancy helping students from Uzbekistan and Tajikistan get accepted into universities abroad, free of charge to the student.

Universe In matches students in Central Asia with partner universities in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UAE, Germany, France, Ireland, and the Netherlands. The service is free to students — Universe In is compensated by partner universities after a successful enrollment. Services include university and program matching, application support, visa guidance, and scholarship/state-funding guidance (including Bolashak and El-Yurt Umidi).

Founded and operated in London, UK (27 Inglis Way, Wrest House, NW7 1TP).

## Key facts

- Cost to students: free — Universe In is paid by partner universities, not students
- Typical timeline: 4–8 weeks from first conversation to offer; visa processing adds 4–12 weeks depending on destination
- Minimum IELTS: many partner programs accept pathway routes from IELTS 5.0 or below
- Visa success rate: 94% of supported students receive their visa on the first application
- Contact: info@universein.uk / +447808165945
